result.final_answer: Cargo.toml declares 28 members under crates: repeated chip-* prefix groups (core, fx, session, turns, compute, pax, project, graph, wasm, decision, corpus, remote, native, inference). README.md says chip-core-0 is the base crate every other member builds on; package descriptions otherwise only say each crate owns one responsibility, so specific duties are not established. Manifests show all other members depend on chip-core-0, with layered links from early fx/session/turns into compute/pax/project/graph/wasm/decision/corpus/remote/native/inference variants; dev dependencies are external test support. They do not show APIs, runtime behavior, or why responsibilities are split.
